decisions.reason: Official broad department exists, but opened scope and manufacturing curriculum establish technical manufacturing training rather than a verified operations/industrial-engineering academic unit.

sources.note: Manufacturing and Industrial Technology page describes drafting, manufacturing, electronics and general engineering training; not an Industrial Engineering department.
Full college department and division names verified.
Imported department exists; programme areas are computing, aviation, drafting, general engineering and manufacturing technology.
Business department scope broadly management, leadership, accounting, finance, projects and marketing; no named operations/logistics unit established.
Manufacturing technology and technical certificate offerings inspected.
Manufacturing Technology curriculum read: machining, welding, fabrication, measurement, CNC and quality inspection technical skills; no IE/OR organizational unit established.

limitations: Relevant manufacturing/industrial technology education exists, but no qualifying IE/OR/operations department was verified. Continuing-education logistics course link is not treated as a department.
